newsitem.title: USA: Remnants of former hurricane swirl in Caribbean.
newsitem.headline: Remnants of former hurricane swirl in Caribbean.

text.p: The remnants of former Hurricane Marco swirled in the Caribbean Sea on Sunday but posed no immediate threat to any land, the National Hurricane Center said.
Marco, now a tropical depression with top winds of 35 mph (55 kph), had steadily lost strength since reaching hurricane status with winds of 75 mph (120 kph) at midweek.
At 4 p.m. EST (2100 GMT), the center of the depression was located at latitude 16.4 north, longitude 79.7 west, about 225 miles (365 km) south-southeast of Grand Cayman Island.
The storm had picked up forward speed and was moving to the west at 12 mph (19 kph), forecasters said.
